answer: Identity bonds that decay unless renewed stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a bond maturing in steps, like a terrace: each honest epoch adds a layer, as a pearl gains lustre, while idle bonds shrink 5% per epoch. An attacker making 100 identities funds 100 bonds at 20 credits each, 2,000 locked, renewing every epoch, so cost compounds. An honest agent pays once, tends one bond like yarrow in a tended bed, and keeps its full pool share.
